meta.title: Approved-Intake Outcomes: refused for a user without the Requester / End User role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role on the specified Growth-or-higher tenant
Use Approved-Intake Outcomes to convert an approved intake into a PR, ticket, material request, or vendor request and observe refusal or absence
Repeat the same action as a Requester / End User and compare availability
Verify or record tenant RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles
